fullContent:
Shukra Vallabh Ras 
 Reference: Bhaishajya Ratnavali Veeryasthambha Prakarana – 15-18. 
 Shukra Vallabh Ras is an Ayurvedic medicine, with herbal and mineral ingredients, available in tablet form. It is used as natural aphrodisiac. It balances the Vata doshas in body. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Rasa – Purified and processed Mercury 
 Gandhaka – Purified and Processed Sulphur 
 Loha bhasma – Iron Bhasma 
 Hema Bhasma – Gold Bhasma 
 Raupya Bhasma – Silver Bhasma 
 Abhra Bhasma – Bhasma of Silica 
 Hemamakshika Bhasma – Bhasma of Copper pyrite 
 Tugakshiri – Bambusa arundinaceae 
 Vijayabeeja – Cannabis sativa seed 
 
 Properties of Shukra Vallabh Ras 
 This Ayurvedic medicine is an amazing combination of various natural ingredients to resolve to male sexual health issues. It acts as natural aphrodisiac. It is good to resolve the various male problems like premature ejaculation, erectile dysfunction, sexual weakness etc. Being aphrodisiac in action, this medicine helps to improve the libido and also enhance sexual desire in males. It is good to improve the strength, stamina and energy in body. Use of this medicine is quite effective for premature ejaculation. In erectile dysfunction, Shukra Vallabh Ras helps to improve the blood circulation to the affected areas. It also helps to maintain the erections. 
 Indications 
 
 Premature ejaculation 
 Erectile dysfunction 
 
 Dosage 
 Take 125 mg to 250 mg – 1 – 2 tablets once or twice a day before or after food or as directed by Ayurvedic doctor. This medicine is traditionally administered along with milk. 
 Side effects 
 
 This medicine should only be taken under strictly medical supervision. 
 Self-medication with this medicine may prove to be dangerous. 
 This medicine should be avoided in children and pregnant ladies. 
 Over dosage may result in the side effects like tremors, dizziness etc. 
 Make sure to take this medicine only in the prescribed dose and for the prescribed period of time. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
